target: http://localhost:3790

Findings (each reproduced twice from scratch)
1. MEDIUM Waterings list crashes on a malformed response and keeps showing the old, unfiltered rows under 'Loading waterings…'
   where: /waterings (GET /api/waterings?bed_id=…)
   expected: A visible load error and no rows from another bed
   saw: ["waterings.value?.reduce is not a function"]
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-183121-hunt-fd1b/probes/waterings-malformed.mjs (expectation "malformed-list-no-crash")
2. MEDIUM Opening Waterings when the list answer is not an array crashes the navigation and leaves the user on the previous page
   where: /waterings (GET /api/waterings)
   expected: The Waterings page opens and shows a load error
   saw: {"s":["Partial shade","Shade","Notes","Add bed","All beds","North bed","Full sun","PLANTS","2","HARVESTED","2.55 kg","LAST WATERED"],"pe":["waterings.value?.reduce is not a function"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-183121-hunt-fd1b/probes/dashboard-faults.mjs (expectation "list-empty-object-not-shown-as-empty")
3. MEDIUM Dashboard shows a bad watering response as 'No waterings yet'
   where: / (GET /api/waterings?limit=5)
   expected: An error in Recent waterings
   saw: {"s":["Recent waterings","All waterings","No waterings yet","Use “Water now” on a bed to record one.","Go to beds","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"],"pe":[]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-183121-hunt-fd1b/probes/dashboard-faults.mjs (expectation "dash-empty-object-not-shown-as-empty")
4. MEDIUM Dashboard renders a malformed watering response as rows of 'Never' with blank beds
   where: / (GET /api/waterings?limit=5)
   expected: An error message in Recent waterings
   saw: {"s":["Recent waterings","All waterings","The five most recent waterings","WHEN\tBED\tAMOUNT","Never\t\t–","Never\t\t–","Never\t\t–","Never\t\t–"],"pe":[]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-183121-hunt-fd1b/probes/dashboard-faults.mjs (expectation "dash-malformed-no-crash")
5. MEDIUM Changing the bed filter while the request hangs leaves 'Loading waterings…' forever, with the previous unfiltered rows still shown
   where: /waterings (bed filter)
   expected: The old rows are cleared or marked stale, and the request times out with an error
   saw: ["Shade corner","Clear filter","Loading waterings…","Watering log","Waterings, most recent first","WHEN\tBED\tAMOUNT","ACTIONS","12 Nov 2026, 18:33\tShade corner\t–\tDelete","watering of Shade corner","12 Nov 2026, 18:32\tNorth bed\t–\tDelete","watering of North bed","5 Nov 2026\tShade corner\t4 L\tDelete","watering of Shade corner","1 Nov 2026\tNorth bed\t10 L\tDelete"]
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-183121-hunt-fd1b/probes/waterings-hang.mjs (expectation "hang-no-stale-other-bed-rows")
